title: Internal Network Lateral Movement and Proxy Chains
description: Establish a path first, then scan; route tools through the proxy
detail:
1. Determine connectivity: outbound ICMP/TCP/DNS (ping, curl, nslookup)
2. Pivot paths (based on available resources): ssh -D dynamic forwarding, frp (tcp/socks5), chisel, venom, reGeorg (web)
3. Proxy chain: configure socks5 in proxychains4 and route tools through it consistently
4. Internal scanning: prefer lightweight tools first (fscan/nbtscan); limit nmap rate with -T2 --max-retries 1 (to avoid triggering monitoring or causing outages)
5. Prioritize targets: domain controllers, operations hosts, databases, backup servers (rich in secrets)
Key to multi-hop assessments: create host facts for each new subnet and do not lose pivots you have already gained (record the pivot in data).
